verdict.rationale: The docs say a dot lives in the cloud with its own computer and browser and keeps working while your machine is off. They also describe it handling website logins through a private credential form with optional saved passwords, and a Take over / Return control handoff on its computer, which together show first-party browser operation on websites. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of web research workflows and the depth of browser actions (navigation, form completion, multi-step site tasks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
